Lena (Sales): Heads-up: vendor-risk wants focused answers on encryption/KMS for their CAIQ section. Need a short customer-ready paragraph + a few bullets for BYOK/HSM/rotation.
Marco (Security): Short paragraph: Redwood uses envelope encryption (DEKs wrapped by CMKs). At-rest: AES-256-GCM. In-transit: TLS 1.3 with modern AEAD ciphers. We support Redwood-managed keys, customer-managed cloud KMS (BYOK), and HSM-backed private keys for Private deployments.
Ivy (Solutions): Bullets for portal:
- BYOK: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault; we store only the key reference and invoke the customer KMS for crypto ops.
- HSM: CloudHSM or on-prem HSM via PKCS#11; key material never leaves the HSM boundary.
- Rotation: CMK rotation via KMS native rotation or customer-triggered; DEKs rotated per-tenant. Rotating CMK does not force immediate re-encryption due to envelope model; optional rewrap job available.
Lena (Sales): Can we give a tiny example and a note about logs/audit?
Ivy (Solutions): Example grant (AWS):
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id $CMK_ARN --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/service --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey
```
Marco (Security): Audit: all KMS ops logged (GenerateDataKey/Encrypt/Decrypt/ReEncrypt). Hosted customers can forward logs to S3/SIEM; private deployments integrate with customer SIEM. Compromise runbook: immediate rotation, optional rewrap, full audit export and incident support.
Ticket Bot: Created VR-762 to track CAIQ attachments, ETA 2 business days.
Lena (Sales): Thanks — I'll paste this into their portal and request a 30-min follow-up with Marco/Ivy if they want a deeper dive. :thumbsup:
